topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory welcome and frames the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and PRRs
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns, pattern recognition receptors, and downstream inflammasome activation.

topics.label: Inflammatory cell activation, leukocyte trafficking, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how the inflammatory response is mobilized through sentinel cell signaling, leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic trafficking, and systemic physiological reactions.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: They explain the mechanisms that terminate inflammation, coordinate tissue repair, and manage unresolved or chronic inflammatory conditions.

topics.label: Conclusion and next lecture preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the subject of the upcoming lecture.
